lane: fault-zone anatomy: where secondary strands sit around known faults

hypotheses.title: Joint (distance, relative strike) stratum target fitted to genuinely-new faults
hypotheses.physical_signature: per-fault damage-zone intensity with width growing with displacement, plus the axial orientation of that intensity field as the strand direction
hypotheses.why_it_catches_a_fault_missing_from_the_: it is fitted to faults that are absent from the catalogue by construction, so it never re-predicts mapped geometry, and the sub-parallel class that the organiser penalises is down-weighted
hypotheses.differs_from: this repository's earlier tight-on-catalogue anatomy surfaces and every registry placement measured so far
hypotheses.status: implemented, validated on format and registry, quantified against 15 owner-reported scores

hypotheses.title: Slip-sense conditioned damage zone
hypotheses.physical_signature: per-host intensity split by recorded sense of slip (N / RL / LL)
hypotheses.why_it_catches_a_fault_missing_from_the_: dextral strands in a distributed shear zone predict differently from range-front normal strands
hypotheses.differs_from: H57-J's sense-transition interaction, which was tested on the catalogue holdout only
hypotheses.status: implemented in src/gems57/offcatalogue.py (sense_structure) and measured on the off-catalogue instrument; NOT yet applied to the placement surface, so it is untested as a placement term

hypotheses.title: Fault-tip termination anatomy
hypotheses.physical_signature: end-cap / stress-lobe intensity around catalogue tips, anisotropy-weighted
hypotheses.why_it_catches_a_fault_missing_from_the_: splay tips and stepovers nucleate ahead of mapped tips
hypotheses.differs_from: H57-B (tip-lobe), listed but never run in this repository
hypotheses.status: not run in Session 7; budget exhausted

hypotheses.title: Flight-line-aligned magnetic mimic suppression
hypotheses.physical_signature: linear texture aligned to survey flight lines
hypotheses.why_it_catches_a_fault_missing_from_the_: removes a non-geological artefact class before ranking candidates
hypotheses.differs_from: every lineament approach that treats survey artefacts as faults
hypotheses.status: not run in Session 7; needs the 19-band feature stack and a named external source for the line geometry

negative_results_this_session: The off-catalogue proxy truth cannot rank placements: Spearman with owner-reported live scores is -0.928 at full density and non-positive at every subsample density (evidence/offcat_instrument_check.json).

The inherited catalogue holdout rewards tight-on-catalogue placement, which the live evidence penalises; the two instruments disagree about the target population (evidence/portfolio_live_evidence.json).
